title: What Happens If You Stop Eating? (Day by Day)
description:
What happens if you stop eating? Day by day, here's what your body does... and how one man went 382 days without a meal.

Bite a lemon in your head, make a fist, breathe on your hand, and count your pulse for six seconds: four tests you can do right now, sitting down. Your stomach growls to clean itself, hunger rings like an alarm clock and then goes quiet, the liver's sugar stash runs low in a day or two, and around day three your body switches to burning fat. How many beats did you count in six seconds?

A hiker snowed into a mountain hut for a week, with Pip's favourite chocolate on the table and a fox that stole his food. The 1944 Minnesota volunteers on half rations, whose pulse fell to about 37 beats a minute. Angus Barbieri, who lived on water and vitamins under medical supervision for 382 days in 1965-66. Please don't try any of this: a fast like that needs doctors, and after days without food the first meals have to start small. A short animated film, made entirely in code. Next week: what happens if you stop brushing your teeth.
